payload.title: The registry severity vocabulary still has spellings next to the new owners: Finding.severity keeps its own literal union, plan_convergence keeps KNOWN_SEVERITIES, and the validator's usage text spells the four severities again
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_convergence.py:130 (KNOWN_SEVERITIES; the module imports parse_finding_id from the owner at line 16)
tools/gates/finding-registry-store.ts:26 (FindingSeverity, derived from the owner's FINDING_SEVERITIES: the form the others do not take)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept and the architectural-solution hierarchy tiers 1 and 3: the grammar of a finding id has one owner per language, and a second spelling of it is detected at build time
payload.notes: Close condition: Finding.severity is FindingSeverity (or the store's type moves to the chain), plan_convergence builds KNOWN_SEVERITIES from finding_id_grammar.FINDING_SEVERITIES or uses it directly, and the usage text is built from the owner's list. The three spellings are gone.
